definitions.explanation: The amount of time that has passed since a starting point, such as the start of an event, a stopwatch, or a process.

examples.japanese: {経過|けいか}{時間|じかん}を{記録|きろく}する。
スタートからの{経過|けいか}{時間|じかん}を{表示|ひょうじ}する。
examples.english: to display the time elapsed since the start.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}{開始|かいし}からの{経過|けいか}{時間|じかん}を、{看護師|かんごし}が{常|つね}に{確認|かくにん}していた。
examples.english: The nurse was constantly checking the time elapsed since the start of the surgery.

notes:
Compound of {経過|けいか} (passage, elapsing) + {時間|じかん} (time). The time counted forward from a starting moment; common in sports timing, computing, and medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経過|けいか}{時間|じかん}を{計|はか}る: to measure elapsed time
- {経過|けいか}{時間|じかん}{表示|ひょうじ}: elapsed-time display

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {残|のこ}り{時間|じかん}: remaining time — the opposite direction (counting down)
- {所要|しょよう}{時間|じかん}: required time — the full time a task takes
